# Farrukh Abdullah — Semantic SEO & Generative Engine Optimization

> Farrukh Abdullah is a Semantic SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategist based in Faisalabad, Pakistan, working with growth-stage brands, B2B companies, and local service businesses globally. Services include Semantic SEO & Topical Authority, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Local SEO Services. Certified by IBM, Moz, and BrightLocal.

## Services

- [Semantic SEO & Topical Authority](/services/semantic-seo): Entity mapping, topical authority architecture, and content restructuring for search engines and AI models.
- [AI SEO Consulting (GEO)](/services/ai-seo-consulting): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and technical AI-crawler accessibility — structuring content and technical signals to secure citations in ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- [Local SEO Services](/services/local-seo): Local map pack visibility, Google Business Profile optimization, and localized landing page systems for service businesses.

## Case Studies

- [Semantic SEO structuring & entity clustering — Windcave](/case-studies/windcave): +112% organic lead registrations within 9 months through entity-based topical authority restructuring for a global payment gateway.
- [Local SEO systems for competitive service niches](/case-studies/local-seo-systems): 1,200+ inbound calls and 340% average ROI across a local SEO site portfolio in competitive US service niches.
- [Semantic SEO & AI/LLM alignment — Azuno](/case-studies/azuno): +120% organic traffic in 4 months and top 3 local rankings for a San Francisco SaaS analytics platform through semantic content structuring and AI/LLM alignment.
- [Local SEO — Armadillo Coffee Roasters](/case-studies/armadillo-coffee-roasters): An Austin, TX specialty roaster moved from page three of Google to the local map pack with Google Business Profile optimization, CoffeeShop schema, and neighborhood service-area pages.
- [Local SEO — The Reese Law Centre LLC](/case-studies/reese-law-centre): A Homewood, IL law firm doubled local-lead calls with LegalService schema, practice-area pages, and consistent directory citations.
- [Geo-targeted Local SEO — Hotel Circa 39](/case-studies/hotel-circa-39): A Miami Beach boutique hotel gained visibility in exactly the neighborhoods it targeted, with organic bookings up 35%.
- [Semantic & E-Commerce SEO — Swag Pro](/case-studies/swag-pro): Technical fixes and entity-based product architecture made organic sales a Denver merchandise business's main revenue stream within three months.
- [Local SEO — South Seattle Women's Fitness](/case-studies/south-seattle-womens-fitness): A Seattle fitness studio reached consistent top-three local rankings and a steady stream of new members with neighborhood-precise local SEO.
- [Semantic SEO — Simulithic](/case-studies/simulithic): Entity-based semantic architecture and LLM-aligned content give a YC-backed AI product a machine-readable edge in a category without established search vocabulary.
